goal: Is ke baad aap Bubble Sort se array sort kar sakte hain, samjha sakte hain ke har pass mein kya hota hai, bata sakte hain ke inner loop chhota kyun hota jata hai, aur chaar ya paanch numbers par ek pass haath se trace kar sakte hain.
warmup: Socho paanch students assembly ke liye line mein khare hain, aur teacher kehti hain: qad ke hisaab se khare ho jao, sab se chhota pehle. Aap poori line ek saath nahi dekh sakte, is liye sirf do aas paas khare students ko dekhte hain. Agar left wala lamba hai to woh jagah badal lete hain. Aap line mein chalte hue har pair ke saath yehi karte hain. Chalne ke end tak sab se lamba student dhakel kar bilkul right end tak pohanch jata hai, jaise glass ke paani mein bubble upar uthta hai. Phir aap yehi chakkar dobara lagate hain, lekin aakhri student pehle hi sahi jagah par hota hai, is liye har dafa aap ek jagah pehle ruk jate hain.
definition: Bubble Sort array ko sort karne ka ek aasaan tareeqa hai. Yeh baar baar do AAS PAAS ke elements ko compare karta hai aur agar woh ghalat order mein hon to swap kar deta hai. Array ke saath ek poore chakkar ko pass kehte hain. Pass 1 ke baad sab se bari value bubble ho kar aakhri position par pohanch jati hai. Pass 2 ke baad doosri sab se bari value aakhri se pehli position par hoti hai, aur isi tarah. N elements ke array ko ziyada se ziyada N - 1 passes chahiye. Ascending sort ka matlab hai sab se chhota pehle. Descending sort ka matlab hai sab se bara pehle.
howItWorks: Visualize tab kholein aur Play dabayein. Bars ko dekhein. Jin do bars ka compare ho raha hai woh highlight hote hain. Agar left bar lamba ho to woh swap ho jate hain. Logic chaar lines mein yeh hai. (1) Outer loop: pass = 0 se N - 2 tak. Yaani N - 1 passes. (2) Inner loop: j = 0, jab tak j < N - 1 - pass. Har step mein a[j] ko a[j + 1] se compare karein. (3) Agar a[j] > a[j + 1] ho to temporary variable se unhein swap karein. (4) Inner loop ke baad sab se bari unsorted value apni final jagah par hoti hai. Inner loop chhota kyun hota hai? Pass 0 ke baad aakhri 1 value final ho jati hai. Pass 1 ke baad aakhri 2 values final ho jati hain. Is liye pass number 'pass' ko sirf pehli N - pass values dekhni hoti hain, yaani aakhri pair jo compare hoga woh (N - 2 - pass, N - 1 - pass) hai, aur isi wajah se condition j < N - 1 - pass hai. Comparisons ginna: pass 0 mein N - 1, pass 1 mein N - 2, ... aakhri pass mein 1. Total (N - 1) + (N - 2) + ... + 1 = N(N - 1) / 2 hota hai. N = 5 ke liye yeh 10 hai. Optional behtari: swapped naam ka bool flag use karein. Har pass ke shuru mein usay false karein aur swap hone par true. Agar ek poora pass khatam ho jaye aur swapped abhi bhi false ho, to array pehle se sorted hai aur hum break kar sakte hain. Descending order ke liye sirf comparison badlein: a[j] < a[j + 1] use karein.
